    Lemma 2.5: strict radical layers #

    Lemma 2.5 (lem:strict-radical-layers, graded-category.tex). Let J be the radical of the category of finite-length modules and let a : U → Y be a radical monomorphism such that a + h is monic for every h ∈ J²(U, Y). Then for every W and n ≥ 1, a ∘ z ∈ J^n(W, Y) ⇔ z ∈ J^{n-1}(W, U). Every direct sum of left almost split inclusions satisfies the hypothesis.

    This file proves the lemma in an additive category with kernels and binary biproducts, for the categorical radical ideal I (the vendored homIdeal) and its powers, under two hypotheses which hold for mod A:

    • every object Y has a right radical approximation: a radical map p : E → Y through which every radical map into Y factors, with a radical monic kernel i : T → E such that every map in I²(T, Z) is i ≫ q with q radical (in the manuscript, p is the sum of the minimal right almost split maps of the summands of Y, with rad P → P at projective summands, and i is a sum of left almost split inclusions);
    • the Krull–Schmidt normal form: every map becomes, after an isomorphism of its source, a row of a split monomorphism and a radical map (the manuscript's "split off the invertible blocks of u").

    The proof is the manuscript's: the identity p ∘ J^n(W, E) = J^{n+1}(W, Y) (eq:right-radical-surjection), splitting off the given monomorphism, the complementary monomorphism b with the same perturbation property, and induction on the radical degree for all such monomorphisms simultaneously. In Lean composition is written z ≫ a for the manuscript's a ∘ z, and the exponents are shifted: z ≫ a ∈ I^{n+1} implies z ∈ I^n.
